practice.title: 问路与指路
practice.phrase: How can I get to the train station?
practice.phonetic: /haʊ kæn aɪ ɡet tə ðə treɪn ˈsteɪʃən/
practice.summary: 学习礼貌问路，并听懂常见方向表达。
practice.heading: 怎么询问去某个地点的路线？
practice.meaning: How can I get to ...? 表示“我怎么去……？”，适用于询问车站、酒店或景点。
practice.answerTip: 问路前先说 Excuse me 会更礼貌。听路线时留意 straight、left、right。
sample: Excuse me. Are you looking for somewhere?
打扰一下，你在找地方吗？
Yes. How can I get to the train station?
practice.welcome: 欢迎进入“问路与指路”主题。我们会练习礼貌问路并理解方向。
practice.vocabIntro: 接下来的对话会用到 excuse、get、station、straight、left 和 right。

warmup.sentence: How can I get the train station?
warmup.explanation: 表示“到某地”需要介词 to：get to the station。
correction: How can I get the train station?
How can I get to the train station?

fills.fullSentence: How can I get to the station?
fills.reason: get to 表示“到达某地”。

fills.assist: 说出一个能与 turn 搭配的方向词。
fills.reason: turn left / turn right 都是正确的方向表达。
fills.memoryTip: 方向表达：turn left / turn right。
fills.alternativeExplanation: left 和 right 都可以放在 turn 后构成正确的方向指令，你的答案不会被误判。

briefing: 你在陌生街区寻找火车站，Maya 是路过的当地人。
请先礼貌询问路线，再确认直走和转弯方向。
practice.hint: Excuse me. How can I get to the train station?
practice.opening: Hi there! Are you looking for somewhere?
practice.openingZh: 你好！你在找什么地方吗？
demoAnswers: Yes. How can I get to the station?

coachTurns.bridge: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. Would you like me to repeat that?
coachTurns.nativeAssist: 当然。直走两个街区，然后左转。需要我重复一遍吗？

coachTurns.bridge: Then turn left at the corner. Can you tell me the directions back?
coachTurns.nativeAssist: 对，先直走，然后在拐角左转。你能复述一下路线吗？

coachTurns.bridge: The station will be on your right. You completed the directions role-play.
coachTurns.nativeAssist: 完全正确！车站就在右手边。你已经完成问路对话。
